displayMode.recommendation: 5-8 岁儿童默认单语展示；家长共读或英语启蒙时可开启中英对照。

mergeRules: Arrays of objects with stable id fields are replaced by the locale array or merged by id if the renderer supports it.
Arrays of plain strings are replaced by the locale array.
Non-text structural fields such as id, slug, href, asset, status, groupId and correctOptionId must remain stable across locales.

copyPolicy.childCopy: Use short, concrete sentences. Avoid encyclopedia tone.
copyPolicy.parentCopy: Use clear explanatory notes for adults; keep them brief and actionable.
copyPolicy.technicalTerms: Keep the Chinese term and English term aligned in bilingual mode when the term is important, e.g. 大模型 / Large Language Model.
copyPolicy.aiSafety: Never say AI thinks exactly like a person or always tells the truth.
